name: Inspect SSD service
command: set -euo pipefail; env_file="${UA_WHATBOX_ENV_FILE:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/upload-assistant/whatbox.env}"; set -a; source "$env_file"; set +a; export SSHPASS="$UA_WHATBOX_PASSWORD"; sshpass -e ssh -4 -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PreferredAuthentications=password -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes artemisprime@clementine.whatbox.ca 'set -e; cd /mnt/nvme11n1/artemisprime/Upload-Assistant-wastaken; printf "checkout="; pwd; find . -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf "%f\n" | sort | head -40; podman ps --format "{{.Names}}\t{{.Image}}\t{{.Status}}"; podman compose -f docker-compose.local.yml config --services'
description: Inspect Clementine SSD files and running Podman service after checkout check failed.
